{"version":1,"assetType":"character-concept","name":"vn-wave-a-neutral-ky-an-northeast-v2","input":{"assetType":"character-concept","name":"vn-wave-a-neutral-ky-an-northeast-v2","prompt":"Generate ONE isolated standing neutral FULL BODY pixel game sprite for Kỷ An. One figure only, transparent RGBA, request1024x1536. No animation sheet, duplicate figure, text, arrows, grid, scene, floor, cast shadow, aura or FX. Leave clear alpha margins around crown, boots and all props.

IMAGE1 is the live Wang Lin Pixel02 in NORTHEAST: PRIMARY target camera, human chibi anatomy, head/body proportions, broad pixel clusters and few-tone material shading. IMAGE2 is this SAME NPC accepted Southeast calibration identity, enlarged nearest8x; ONLY face/hair/clothes/colors/physical prop hand identity. Its Southeast orientation is NOT this target. Reconstruct the same NPC in image1 camera, not Wang identity. DO NOT keep image2 Southeast camera and DO NOT mirror/flip an image.

Same NPC identity: Preserve pale-blue/ivory robe, the specifically accepted SHORT low-tied dark hair with blue ribbon, adult diligent face, belt water gourd and compact bamboo slips. No high bun, long ponytail, staff, qi cloud or new ornament. Keep the same large head/short torso and legs.

MANDATORY target camera: This ONE neutral pose remain NORTHEAST back-right three-quarter facing screen up-right, identical rear camera and body axes to IMAGE1. Show the back-right view throughout all18poses. Back hair, shoulders and robe dominate; do not reveal a front face, both eyes, front chest or palms through the torso. Held objects at front waist are naturally partly or fully hidden. Visible motion uses slight head inclination, shoulder/forearm changes and naturally exposed prop edges, never relocation of front-held props to the back. Show the back-right view throughout all18poses. Back hair, shoulders and robe dominate; do not reveal a front face, both eyes, front chest or palms through the torso. Held objects at front waist are naturally partly or fully hidden. Visible motion uses slight head inclination, shoulder/forearm changes and naturally exposed prop edges, never relocation of front-held props to the back.

Anatomical handedness and attachments: Both hands support the SAME compact bamboo slips before abdomen; blue gourd remains attached at anatomical RIGHT hip (screen-left FRONT, screen-right BACK). Short tied hair/ribbon remains low; never tall bun. Water gourd remains on the same original physical belt attachment for all18poses. Bamboo slips remain in their original hands and merely tilt/lift slightly. Do not put the gourd on the ground, duplicate it, add paper, or emit qi; no hand detachment.

Occlusion: Bamboo slips are held at front waist/low chest and remain occluded by her body in direct North; back-quarter views expose only the natural side edge. Belt gourd remains on the original physical side, showing or hiding with camera rotation instead of teleporting to the near side. Reading head incline and shoulder breath provide rear motion; no front palms or face revealed.

Calm original resting grip, boots planted and full body visible. Front-waist props naturally disappear behind torso in back views; never show hands through cloth. Do not move props to a different hand just to display them. Minimal logical back of same clothes; no new emblem/pouch/ornament/weapon.

Keep own accepted head/skull/short torso/legs proportions while matching primary Wang pixel treatment; head/main hair around half standing body. Human native base64x96 foot32,88 standing80px; padded motion96x96 foot48,88. Source dimensions are NOT game scale; one crown-to-boots scale is measured later, no per-body deformation. This is a new same-NPC view candidate to inspect before drawing its actions, not owner-approved motion or runtime.
